'''2005 U.S. National Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG national championship in Columbus, Ohio (2 July 2005, at Origins).<ref name="pc-events05">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050828001521/http://swccgpc.com:80/events.htm 2004/2005 Events: SWCCG 2005 Worlds Qualifiers Listing (updated 27 June 2005)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 28 August 2005.</ref> [[Reid Smith]] and [[Brandon Ruck]] won its two Day 2 byes, and Smith won the opportunity to design a virtual card.<ref name="pc-events05" /> It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

On 12 February 2005 Tournament Advocate [[Michael Carr|Mike Carr]] wrote that "the transition at Decipher" had delayed the Players Committee's plans for Origins.<ref name="pcf-4429-62426">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=62426#62426 Origins?], Michael Carr (mc9457), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (12 February 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226015444/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60229%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> On 15 February he called for volunteer directors: there would be a big tournament, and he wanted people to run side events (sealed, Classic, Open and Secret Squirrel) while it was going on, saying "We are looking to dramatically increase our presence at Origins this year."<ref name="pcf-4429-62756">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=62756#62756 Origins?], Michael Carr (mc9457), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (15 February 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226015444/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60229%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> He added that all Star Wars CCG events at Origins and Gen Con 2005 would be posted on Decipher's system and their results entered into the tournament software.<ref name="pcf-4429-62799">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=62799#62799 Origins?], Michael Carr (mc9457), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (15 February 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226015444/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60229%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> [[Micah Wooten]] wrote that six or more players were coming from Nashville, Tennessee.<ref name="pcf-4429-63486">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=63486#63486 Origins?], Micah Wooten (KeonUlic), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (22 February 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226015444/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60229%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Columbus, Ohio
* '''Dates:''' 2 July 2005 (Origins)<ref name="pc-events05" />
